claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a sealed brown cardboard box; the witness report does not describe it as strange.

risks.risk: The contents of the sealed box are unknown.
risks.proof: A photo or video of the box opened showing the contents.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a sealed carton with no value assigned to contents.

risks.risk: The condition and functionality of anything inside cannot be confirmed.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the item inside or a video showing it working.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not working or unknown condition.

risks.risk: Dimensions and weight are unknown, affecting Lagos delivery and storage cost.
risks.proof: A photo of the box beside a measuring tape or on a scale with readable figures.

risks.risk: It is unclear whether the box is original packaging.
risks.proof: A photo showing any branding, model labels, or seals on the box or contents.
risks.if_unproven: Price as non-original or unknown packaging.

proof_requests: Open the box and photograph the contents.
Provide dimensions and weight, or a photo of the box with a measuring tape and scale.
Provide photos or a video of any item inside working and complete.
response.reason: The witness identifies a sealed cardboard box, so it can be priced at its worst case as a carton with unknown contents.
